defects.description: Released lease entries accumulate without respecting the idle bookkeeping bound.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {Store} from "./store.js"; const s=new Store(); for(let i=0;i<1000;i++){s.put(i,i);const h=s.acquire(i);s.remove(i);s.release(h);} console.log(s.retained().leases);'

defects.why_missed: Default-size correctness checks do not measure relinquished bookkeeping after the ownership lifecycle.
